desc:
A blocky ragdoll sandbox with 150+ mobs. Spawn anything, then launch it, blow it up and watch it fall apart chunk by chunk. Play solo or with friends!

🎁 Use code RELEASE for 250 free coins!

🧟 150+ mobs: zombies, skeletons, dinosaurs, horror creatures, farm animals and more
🧱 3D injuries: every hit carves real chunks out of the body
💥 Guns, TNT, nukes, rockets and an orbital railgun
🔥 Burn, freeze, shock, melt or voxelize anything
🪢 Grab, rope and throw mobs, or feed them to crushers and fans
🧠 Mobs hunt, flee and fight each other!
🗺️ Explore different maps, from flat baseplates to wild valleys
👥 Multiplayer: create a lobby, share its code or invite friends, up to 20 players

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile and Tablet!
